entries.title: Bayonetta

primary.why: The first Bayonetta released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, then reached Wii U, Windows, Switch, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One. Windows is the highest-fidelity archive route because it has a well-supported PC version and Steam provides the current PC release.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows Steam version. Use Nintendo versions only if specifically comparing their Nintendo-themed costume/content extras.

all_releases.reason: skip: lower fidelity than Windows and no required exclusive story content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not use the Nintendo-exclusive sequels as evidence of a PC route for Bayonetta 2 or 3.

entries.title: Bayonetta 2

primary.why: Bayonetta 2 released on Wii U and later Nintendo Switch. The Switch release is the more accessible modern Nintendo route and preserves the full game without an official PC/PlayStation/Xbox release.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Nintendo Switch version. Use Wii U only for original-hardware comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: superseded by the more accessible Switch route for normal play.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern Nintendo route with portable and docked play.
all_releases.reason: primary: best official route for the Nintendo-exclusive sequel.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Switch is the current official route; no PC/PlayStation/Xbox release is sourced.

entries.remaster_caveats: Nintendo-exclusive sequel; do not invent a PC route.

entries.title: Bayonetta 3

primary.why: Bayonetta 3 is documented as a Nintendo Switch-exclusive release. With no official alternate platform, the Switch version is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Nintendo Switch version on official hardware.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one official platform is sourced.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster or non-Switch release is logged.

entries.title: Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon

primary.why: Bayonetta Origins is a prequel/spin-off released for Nintendo Switch. With no official alternate platform, the Switch version is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Nintendo Switch version on official hardware.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one official platform is sourced.

entries.remaster_caveats: Prequel/spin-off; do not treat it as Bayonetta 4.
